import http.client, json, socket
class C(http.client.HTTPConnection):
    def connect(self):
        self.sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX)
        self.sock.connect('/var/run/dstack.sock')
def call(m, b):
    c = C('localhost')
    c.request('POST', '/v1/' + m, json.dumps(b), {'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    r = c.getresponse()
    out = json.loads(r.read())
    assert r.status == 200, out
    return out
k = call('GetKey', {'domain': 'worker-signing', 'algorithm': 'secp256k1'})
i = call('Info', {})
print(json.dumps({'app_id': i['app_id'], 'compose_hash': i['compose_hash'], 'public_key': k['public_key'], 'signature_chain': k['signature_chain'], 'key_provider_info': i['key_provider_info']}))
